finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for Dream Town. Match existing cozy painterly isometric town art: creamy plaster, terracotta roofs, dark oak, jewel green foliage, soft sunlight from upper left, polished hand painted 3D illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 sprites in strict row-major order. Equal sized cells, each subject centered, at least 15 percent empty padding on EVERY side inside every cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Row 1: sugarcane farm plot with tall segmented canes; sugar factory cottage with crushing rollers; hops farm trellises with dangling hop cones; tavern with beer barrel and tankard sign. Row 2: medicinal herb garden with drying rack; pig farm with three pink pigs; butcher shop with sausage links under awning; hunter lodge with bow and forest supplies. Row 3: sugar cubes and sugar sack; amber beer tankard and small barrel; bundle of medicinal herbs; neatly displayed meat cut and sausage links, no gore. Genuinely transparent alpha background and gutters. No checkerboard, solid background, captions, typography, watermarks or grid lines. No extra sprites. Whole subjects, no clipping. Buildings on small individual isometric grass/stone foundations. Aim for 2048px wide high quality sheet.
